title: Chapter 6018: Omni Destruction Seal
content:
Chapter 6018: Omni Destruction Seal

Chapter 6018: Omni Destruction Seal

Smoke Fiend and Greatsword channeled their internal energy just to be able to stand against Omni’s imperial aura.

“You are not wrong, Fellow Daoist.” Omni spoke: “Unfortunately, that only applies when Unrivalled Monarch is around but given the current state of your Splendor Terra, that is not the case.”

The duo snorted after hearing this.

Omni gazed at the highest palace and said: “From what I can see, a disaster has come knocking on your door.”

“You do not need to worry, Fellow Daoist, we can deal with it.” Smoke Fiend said.

“Is that so? Why is your Vajra Terra Barrier gone? Is your Unrivalled Monarch still alive? If not, your fate is sealed.” Omni had a smirk on his face.

The crowd became curious. Although they were here to siege the immortal palace, they had no further information regarding Splendor Terra’s crisis.

Given Unrivalled Monarch’s power and Splendor Terra’s resources, few in Sin could have done this. Immortal Suppressor might be one of them but she had not participated.

“What kind of disaster are you dealing with? Enlighten everyone.” Buddha Fiend chuckled and asked, wanting everyone to have a chance to gloat at another’s misery.

Smoke Fiend only scowled and didn’t elaborate.

“I would appreciate it if you would hand that horn over.” Omni repeated, exerting his aura again since he didn’t wish to waste time.

Regular cultivators couldn’t move an inch while Buddha Fiend and the others maintained a safe distance.

“You cannot change our stance, kill us first if you wish to obtain the treasure.” Greatsword, albeit weaker, still activated his aura to resist.

“Then I will have to do what I must. Excuse me then.” Omni sighed and shook his head before raising one hand, creating an omnipresent seal.

Greatsword and Smoke Fiend became startled for a second before taking action.

“One sword to fill up the cosmo!” Greatsword roared, releasing his twelve dao fruits to empower his sword dao. His actual blade floated upward, expanding constantly.

Smoke Fiend inhaled his pipe and spewed smoke, activating a dao of smoke and fire with his anima. It took the form of a phoenix coiling around his anima tree.

“Smoke Phoenix Incineration!” He shouted and the phoenix tore space apart with its existence. With a flap of its wings, countless meteors descended toward Omni Emperor.

“Clank!” Greatsword’s slash cut through the stars along its trajectory, working together with the smoke phoenix.

Serpent-winged Specter Saint and Buddha Fiend became startled and activated their defensive barriers since they were nearest.

“Not bad.” Omni smiled and sent the seal toward the two opponents: “Omni Destruction Seal.”

The world turned dark in the face of an apocalypse due to the presence of the seal.

The gigantic sword and smoke phoenix still couldn’t stop it. The phoenix bellowed before dispersing into nothingness; the sword exploded and shattered.

Greatsword and Smoke Fiend were blasted away, spraying blood everywhere and crashing into the barrier of the palace. They were bloodied and beaten with numerous broken bones.

The difference in power was obvious after just one exchange. Treasures and weapons alone couldn’t make up for the gap in cultivation.

“I’m afraid you cannot stop me, Fellow Daoists. It would be a different story if Unrivalled Monarch were here, I would leave right away.” Omni said before approaching the palace.

“It’s over for Splendor Terra.” The attackers thought while observing Omni Emperor’s unbeatable might.

Smoke Fiend and Greatswords were the strongest ancestors of Splendor Terra. Their only hope was Unrivalled Monarch at this point who was nowhere to be seen.

“Buzz.” The two disappeared into the momentum and shouted: “Initiate the immortal momentum!”

“Boom!” Rounds of light burst forth from the palaces, seemingly opening up the mountain. Chaos true energy gushed out and carried the might of primal ancestors. They served to empower the six supreme treasures displayed in the highest palace.

“Six Treasures Suppression!” The members of Splendor Terra sent all of their power into various channels.

Although the six treasures didn’t leave the palace, they sent their power to merge with the supreme momentum.

“Go!” Omni raised both hands in retaliation, revealing his anima tree to push back against the empowered momentum.

As a half-step apex emperor, his tree was larger than anything seen before during this battle.
